lolobuy-product-links-qc-finder.title: LoloBuy Product Links: Find the Right Item and Check QC
lolobuy-product-links-qc-finder.seoTitle: LoloBuy Product Links & QC Finder: How to Check an Item
lolobuy-product-links-qc-finder.description: Find LoloBuy product links, confirm the exact seller and variant, and match warehouse QC photos to the item you ordered.
lolobuy-product-links-qc-finder.standfirst: Start with a product name or category, open the matching listing, and save the seller, option and source URL. Then match the warehouse photographs to that order. This guide explains how to check a broken link, distinguish a catalog result from QC evidence, and keep the correct item through each stage.
lolobuy-product-links-qc-finder.first: Use a product link to identify a specific item, seller and selected option. A spreadsheet result or W2C recommendation is a starting point; it becomes useful buying evidence only after you confirm the live destination. For QC, keep the warehouse photo set tied to the same order reference instead of matching an image from memory.

lolobuy-shipping-calculator-guide.title: LoloBuy Shipping Estimate: Calculator Inputs and Weight Checks
lolobuy-shipping-calculator-guide.seoTitle: LoloBuy Shipping Calculator Guide: Inputs & Weight Checks
lolobuy-shipping-calculator-guide.description: Prepare a LoloBuy shipping estimate with destination, packed dimensions, chargeable weight and complete route totals. Worked examples, not live quotes.
lolobuy-shipping-calculator-guide.standfirst: To prepare a LoloBuy shipping estimate, collect the destination, packed weight, outer dimensions and route billing rule. This page explains the inputs and shows how to check the arithmetic; it does not calculate a live carrier quote. Replace provisional measurements with final warehouse data before paying.
lolobuy-shipping-calculator-guide.first: A shipping calculator is useful only when its inputs describe your parcel. Before warehouse arrival, label weight and dimensions as assumptions. After packing, replace them with measured values and compare eligible routes again. This guide supplies a checking method and illustrative calculations; current prices and service availability must come from the live quotation for your order.

lolobuy-fees-total-order-cost.title: LoloBuy Fees: Item Cost, Shipping and Total Order Budget
lolobuy-fees-total-order-cost.seoTitle: LoloBuy Fees & Total Cost: A Complete Order Budget
lolobuy-fees-total-order-cost.description: Separate item payments, domestic delivery, warehouse services, international freight and import charges in a practical LoloBuy budget.
lolobuy-fees-total-order-cost.standfirst: Build a LoloBuy budget in five lines: item purchase, domestic delivery, selected warehouse services, international freight and applicable import charges. Mark each amount as paid, quoted or unknown. This prevents double counting and shows which part of the total still depends on the packed parcel.
lolobuy-fees-total-order-cost.first: Create separate budget rows for item price, selected-option charges, domestic delivery, warehouse services, international freight and import handling. Mark each row paid, quoted or unknown, and record its currency. Start from the variant actually selected rather than the lowest listing price. A row without a confirmed amount should remain unknown, not silently become zero.

lolobuy-size-conversion-guide.title: LoloBuy Size Guide: US, UK, EU Labels and Measurements
lolobuy-size-conversion-guide.seoTitle: LoloBuy Size Guide: US, UK, EU & China Size Checks
lolobuy-size-conversion-guide.description: Compare LoloBuy seller size charts, US/UK/EU shoe labels, garment measurements and warehouse QC without assuming one universal conversion.
lolobuy-size-conversion-guide.standfirst: Use the chart for the exact listing and keep its sizing system visible. For clothing, compare garment measurements with an item you wear; for shoes, distinguish foot length, label size and insole length. A familiar US, UK or EU number is not enough to confirm fit across different sellers and models.
lolobuy-size-conversion-guide.first: The relevant size system is the one attached to your selected listing. A seller may use letter sizes, EU-style numbers, US or UK footwear labels, centimetres or a custom chart. Preserve the original option text and the chart together. Converting a number before identifying its system can create a mismatch that warehouse photographs will not necessarily resolve.

lolobuy-reviews-evidence-guide.title: LoloBuy Reviews: What to Check Before You Order
lolobuy-reviews-evidence-guide.seoTitle: LoloBuy Reviews: Evidence, Red Flags & Order Checks
lolobuy-reviews-evidence-guide.description: Assess LoloBuy reviews by date, sample size, destination, service stage and supporting evidence before deciding which questions to ask.
lolobuy-reviews-evidence-guide.standfirst: A useful LoloBuy review identifies what was ordered, when it happened, the destination and the stage where things went well or wrong. Check those details before relying on a star score. This guide gives you a repeatable way to compare public reports without presenting anecdotes as a representative success rate.
lolobuy-reviews-evidence-guide.first: Record the review date, number of reports and whether the writer provides order-stage details. A star average without that context cannot explain a particular seller, destination or shipping route. Separate what the review documents from what the writer concludes, and keep unresolved questions for your own pre-order checks rather than turning a small sample into a sitewide verdict.

how-to-use-lolobuy-spreadsheet.title: How to Use a LoloBuy Spreadsheet: Find, Check and Order
how-to-use-lolobuy-spreadsheet.seoTitle: How to Use a LoloBuy Spreadsheet: Links, Sizes & QC
how-to-use-lolobuy-spreadsheet.description: Use a LoloBuy spreadsheet to find products, check the live listing, save the exact variant and prepare a warehouse QC checklist.
how-to-use-lolobuy-spreadsheet.standfirst: Search the spreadsheet, open the matching product page, confirm the seller and variant, and save the listing before payment. Then carry that record into warehouse QC and parcel planning. This guide shows what to check at each handoff so a useful find stays connected to the product you actually order.
how-to-use-lolobuy-spreadsheet.first: Start with a product name or category, then open a result whose image and destination match. A LoloBuy spreadsheet helps narrow the search; the live listing supplies the seller, selected option and current terms. Save those details before you order. This simple record prevents a promising thumbnail from becoming your only reference when the warehouse item arrives.

lolobuy-qc-photos-guide.title: LoloBuy QC Photos: What to Check Before Shipping
lolobuy-qc-photos-guide.seoTitle: LoloBuy QC Photos: Size, Condition & Shipping Checklist
lolobuy-qc-photos-guide.description: Review LoloBuy QC photos for item identity, size labels, visible defects and useful measurements before you approve international shipping.
lolobuy-qc-photos-guide.standfirst: Check warehouse photos against the saved order: item identity and quantity first, then the selected size and color, visible condition and any measurement that could change your decision. Request a specific missing view before shipping. A clean photo supports a visual check; it cannot guarantee fit, authenticity or long-term performance.
lolobuy-qc-photos-guide.first: Treat the warehouse photo set as a checkpoint between domestic arrival and international dispatch. Compare it with the order you saved, then identify any missing evidence before approving packing. Check the storage counter and the seller’s action deadline separately in your account. An advertised storage allowance does not establish how long a return or exchange remains available.
lolobuy-qc-photos-guide.sourceNote: Editorial review: 4 October 2026. The checklist distinguishes observable warehouse evidence and illustrative calculations from live service terms. Earlier public platform descriptions are background, not confirmation of the current storage allowance, photo service, fee, return option or route. Check the details attached to your own order before acting.

lolobuy-shipping-cost-guide.title: LoloBuy Shipping Cost: Weight, Dimensions and Route Choices
lolobuy-shipping-cost-guide.seoTitle: LoloBuy Shipping Cost: Weight, Packing & Route Guide
lolobuy-shipping-cost-guide.description: Understand LoloBuy shipping costs, compare actual and dimensional weight, and check packing, route restrictions and import costs before payment.
lolobuy-shipping-cost-guide.standfirst: LoloBuy shipping cost depends on the destination, accepted contents, packed weight and dimensions, and the current route rules. Start with those inputs, compare complete eligible-route quotes, then check packing and import-charge responsibilities. The examples here explain the calculation; they are not fixed prices for your parcel.
lolobuy-shipping-cost-guide.first: To compare LoloBuy shipping costs, use the same destination, contents, packed weight and outer dimensions for each eligible route. Record the quote date, currency and included services. A price from another buyer describes a different parcel and may omit packing or destination charges. Begin with your own warehouse data and keep every unconfirmed cost visibly separate.
lolobuy-shipping-cost-guide.sourceNote: Editorial review: 4 October 2026. The checklist distinguishes observable warehouse evidence and illustrative calculations from live service terms. Earlier public platform descriptions are background, not confirmation of the current storage allowance, photo service, fee, return option or route. Check the details attached to your own order before acting.
